verdict.rationale: The only direct search evidence is an Enterprise feature for a single docs portal where users can 'view and search all of your projects'. That implies reader-facing search across the docs, and Ask AI adds AI-generated answers drawn from published docs. Nothing describes the search engine itself, so the core qualities of the story are unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented built-in full-text search on standard plans, typo tolerance, relevance ranking, speed/performance claims, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
